item: HATCH DESK D1a, D1b and D1-fix; D3 (the writing line and Log)

writing_line.reason: Capture is not permitted for this account (test data): dumpcap needs the wireshark group. Add yourself with your administrator, then sign in again.
writing_line.refused: the last capture is still stopping; try again in a moment. (test data)

checks: 01 At 1920 by 1200, 1366 by 768 and 1280 by 800, each at 14, 18 and 20 pt: every mirrored pair of the panes, the bands, the head and the lower band (the band words by their ink and the cat by its pale coat, both again in the window's own pixels; the word Graphite and the symbol by their outline and optical size), of the panes' tabs, marks, contents, feet, Trash's empty mirror, the three trees and Activity's list rows measures 0 px (201 rows at each); every drawn item (the word, the symbol, every menu and band word, the cat, Trash) matches its design in the window's pixels and the chosen tabs' yellow marks mirror; every pose of the cat lies inside the band with its padding; no script word is cut by its label; every word in the window is whole (the lower band's words smaller in a narrow window, never elided) and nothing in the workspace or either pane scrolls sideways; with Conversation and with Context the right pane's pairs hold too, Half and Tall keep every pair, and the System menu's list opens under the symbol at the band's inset

02 Both bands are the one grain tile from their own top-left: 2760 pixels in 92 columns where no word is drawn are equal in both bands and equal the tile (mean lightness 69.957 in each); the lettering 7.72:1 and the quiet lettering 5.79:1 on the mean tone (7.48:1 and 5.61:1 on the lightest 5% of the grain); the pink action mark 4.17:1 and the yellow active mark 4.68:1
03 Line, Half and Tall: the console above the band is 30, 312 and 504 px; the lower band stays 60 px at y=1140 and the pairs stay at 0 px

04 Over either pane separator the window shows the horizontal resize cursor and its own pointer again off it; dragging the left pane's edge 40 px widened both panes together (380/380 halfway, 400/400 after); dragging the right pane's edge 30 px narrowed both (370/370); an excursion to 18 pt and back kept the owner's width; the session saved 370 for both

05 Ctrl+K puts the cursor in the writing line in Search (D3: Search marked by the short yellow mark, the words typed after it go to Search, the session remembers Search like any mode); the erased symbol (32 px) at the far right is the System menu: Return opens it with Game first and focused and Stop all jobs directly beneath, right-aligned under it; its Game row opens STRUTHIO (struthio_qt.show called once, patched); the head's old mark is out of sight

06 Both panes: the left shows Machine · Cabinet · Settings with only the active tree (connecting branch lines) and Trash, the right Conversation · Activity · Context with the faces; the chosen tab of each carries the pencil-yellow mark (measured in the window's pixels) and every pane pair stays 0 px with each tab chosen

07 Every action a removed pane control reached is reached: Work ▸ Import and Export (the transfers' own destinations, patched), Arrange ▸ Cabinet (Logical / Existing views, the catalogue choice, Refresh) and Refresh Machine View, Find's CABINET and SETTINGS rows, Activity's Timeline words and Work block, the Machine row's tooltip and the Cabinet tab's; none of the old controls shows in the pane

08 In Line the centre foot is empty (the workspace reaches the lower band); a status message shows there while it lasts, a long one wrapped with both panes and every pair unmoved; Half shows the working area above the band with the mode's page (D3: Assignment's answers here; the Timeline is Log's Events stream, step 12)

09 The window's pointer is the mark's two facets, its hotspot (2, 2) the tip exactly, aimed 30.0 degrees left of vertical; the trees, tabs, head and workspace show it, text fields keep the I-beam, the splitter its resize cursor, Trash its hand

10 The quiet-script rule: the word Graphite is the Paper script (Parisienne 33 px, a 0.5 px hairline, its capitals as tall as the symbol), its outline from the band's inset and on the symbol's centre line, and as drawn at the symbol's distance from the edge and as designed (0 px and 0 levels, at all nine sizes in 01); the notes you may skip are the script, whole in their labels: in Activity the selection's explanation and where the work's order, niceness and Stop are (under the printed WORK line); in the System menu's list the captions after ACTIVE JOBS and QUEUED and the sliders' note; Today's capture hint and the Files room's explanation, with their keys printed; the Files room's Open note in Context; the menus, tabs, trees, statuses and the kill switch stay print; View ▸ Pleasantries in script off makes them all print (the word in Plex SemiBold, every pair still 0 px) and on again restores them

12 The writing line (D3): Assignment · Bash · Search · Log, only the chosen one marked by the short yellow mark (in the window's pixels) and every desk pair 0 px with each chosen in Line, Half and Tall at all nine sizes (step 01); the poem placeholder drawn at 4.68:1 on the line's paper (D3-fix); Assignment: files.list says staC on Ctrl+Enter, Enter gives it to Graphite and runs no staC, Ctrl+Enter runs typed staC (desk) through the staC path, its answer in the working area, and Up on the empty line recalls it (the staC target's history, D3-fix); Commands ▸ Run an operation… (Alt+3) is the line with the / lead and runs ops; Search lists results as you type and Enter searches the workspace, the answer's end in sight (D3-fix); Ctrl+K is Search (step 05); Log on Events follows the journal (22 lines, newest last) with nothing to write in it; Log on Network (test data) reads only through network.observe, network.capture.start, network.capture.stop, network.capture.read, filters by the line (Enter), asks once before the first capture (Ctrl+Enter), shows the packet stream, holds a pinned packet while 27 more arrive, reads a capture's last packets when it ends between reads (D3-fix), puts an assignment about it in the line, follows its conversation for D4 (entry_at, focus), stops, says why a capture was refused and keeps saying it (D3-fix), and shows the unavailable reason without offering anything; the session remembers Log and Network

13 The cat, the programs list and the System menu (D2): the cat is pale paper on the band (#fffdf8, the band's brightest value: 9.11:1 on its mean tone, the lettering 7.72:1), graphite eyes and paws, a pink nose and ears, yellow irises only on hover and while the list is open; Reduce motion switches its poses directly; one click opens the list from sleep (the open pose while it is open), Escape closes it; Return opens it with Agenda under focus, typing fi jumps to Files, F1 reads its descriptor, Return opens the Files workspace (navigation, no job); the list holds every capability of the Hatch groups once (23) A to Z and Explore the workshop; the System menu reads Game, Stop all jobs, the process list (the queue's place numbers 1 and 2 and each row's slider), Graphite services On · Off · Restart, then Log out, Exit Graphite, Restart, Shut down with their scope words; here (no login session) the three are unavailable with that reason and run_action refuses before any question; session_power.system is held for the whole run (logind answers no session, on any computer); an unavailable row stays in the keyboard's order and F1 reads its reason; with a fake logind Restart asked the leave flow's questions, the confirmation, then closed the ordinary way (held here) and only then issued the one command (systemctl reboot, through session_power.system, faked); Stop all jobs reached the Master Stop's action; Game opened STRUTHIO; New Idea and New Project are under Work; captures 09 to 14
11 Reopened from the saved session, both panes are 370 px again and every pair measures 0 px; clean close with zero job, worker, model, provider, native or OS session activity

captures.note: The desk at 1920 by 1200, 14 pt, both launch menus closed: the two graphite bands, Graphite in the script at the upper left and the erased symbol at the far right, the eight menus across the workspace with their ink on the writing line's ends, the two panes 360 px each, Activity quiet, Trash at the left pane's lower right.

The same desk with the axis (pink) and the mirrored guides (yellow, dashed): the band insets, the pane edges, the workspace column's inset shared by the menus' ink and the writing line, and the band edges. Every pair measured 0 px.
The desk at 1366 by 768, 14 pt, both launch menus closed: the panes 360 px each, the workspace 644 px, every word whole, the menus on the workspace column.
The tightest case, 1280 by 800 at 20 pt: the panes 374 px, the workspace 530 px, the lower band's words at 23 px so every one is whole, the menus fold Properties · Guide into ⋯; every pair 0 px.

The left pane at 1920 by 1200 with each of its tabs: Machine, Cabinet and Settings, each showing only the tab row, the active tree with its connecting branch lines (the cabinet with a project and its idea opened), and the larger Trash at the lower right; the chosen tab carries the short yellow mark.

The right pane at 1920 by 1200 with each of its tabs: Conversation (the Graphite face), Activity (the Operations panel's work, the Work block when an assignment runs, the Timeline's last lines, Organizer, Return thread, Follow latest) and Context; its foot, where Trash stands in the left pane, is empty.

The pointer: the Graphite mark's two facets aimed at 11 o'clock (30 degrees left of vertical, the dashed lines: vertical and the facets' axis), the click at the tip (the pink square is the hotspot's pixel), drawn crisp at 1x and 2x with a thin paper edge so it reads on paper and on the bands. Offscreen there is no live cursor: the window grab has the cursor image drawn at its hotspot.

The quiet-script rule on the desk at 1920 by 1200: the word Graphite at the upper left in the Paper script, pale on the band, its capitals as tall as the symbol, and in Activity (quiet now: what Graphite did, got and needs) the notes you may skip in the script, whole in their labels (the selection's explanation; where the work's order, niceness and Stop are, under the printed WORK line) while what you act on and read first stays print; right, the same with View ▸ Pleasantries in script off: all print, the word in Plex SemiBold.

The lower band at 1920 by 1200 in each of the writing line's four modes, Assignment · Bash · Search · Log, the active one marked by the short pencil-yellow mark under its word (and only it, measured in the window's pixels); the flat writing line erased into the band with the light poem placeholder; Line · Half · Tall beside the cat. The Shell mode's word is Bash because the configured shell is /bin/bash.

Assignment at 1920 by 1200: above, at Half, the answer of the staC program desk run with Ctrl+Enter through the staC target's own path (stac.run through Kernel.dispatch, read only): a real command; in the line, files.list typed, which parses as staC, so the line's quiet word says staC on Ctrl+Enter and the results under it say Ctrl+Enter runs it, while Enter would give it to Graphite as an assignment.

Search at 1920 by 1200 (Ctrl+K, or the Search word): Bench typed in the line; the results open under it as you type, first the search itself (Enter), then the cabinet's matching records (the project Bench notes) and anything else by name, each opening where it belongs.

Search at 1920 by 1200 after Enter: the workspace searched for Bench in the working area above the line (files and their words, received files, the cabinet, settings, commands and the Timeline), each with open; the whole answer in sight, from its echo to its last line (measured).

Log at Half on Events, 1920 by 1200: Graphite's own events from the activity journal (ledger.activity through Kernel.dispatch) in the Timeline's words, newest at the bottom, Follow latest on; the two small tabs Events and Network at its top; the line filters the stream (Enter). There are no notes: the owner replaced them with the network.

Log at Half on Network, 1920 by 1200, on TEST DATA (the check's fake capability answering D5's four operations with documentation addresses; labelled on the image): the interfaces with their receive and send rates, the connections filtered by port 443 (typed in the line, Enter), and the packet stream of a capture started with Ctrl+Enter after the confirmation (headers only, this computer's interfaces, not promiscuous, 60 seconds or 2000 packets, nothing leaves the computer), newest at the bottom; a packet is pinned at the top with its details and Ask Graphite about this, and stays while 27 more arrive.

The cat in the lower band at 1920 by 1200, 14 pt, its four poses each cut from the window and enlarged three times (pixels kept): pale paper on the graphite band (the workspace's warm paper white #fffdf8, 9.11:1 on the band's mean tone; the lettering 7.72:1), graphite eyes and paws, a soft eraser-pink nose and inner ears, pencil-yellow irises on hover and while the list is open, eyes closed and no yellow asleep; every pose inside the band (step 01 measures it at all nine sizes).

The cat's programs list at 1920 by 1200, 14 pt, opened with Return from the cat: 23 programs and capabilities, one plain name and one small graphite icon each, A to Z (type a name's first letters to jump), then Explore the workshop; a status word at the right where one applies (needs setup); its small caption in the script at the top. It opens upward from the lower left, its left edge the band's inset from the window's edge and its foot on the lower band's top: the point-mirror image of the System menu (Symmetry rule 6, measured at all nine sizes in step 01).

The cat's programs list at 1366 by 768, 14 pt, opened with Return from the cat: 23 programs and capabilities, one plain name and one small graphite icon each, A to Z (type a name's first letters to jump), then Explore the workshop; a status word at the right where one applies (needs setup); its small caption in the script at the top. It opens upward from the lower left, its left edge the band's inset from the window's edge and its foot on the lower band's top: the point-mirror image of the System menu (Symmetry rule 6, measured at all nine sizes in step 01).

The System menu at 1920 by 1200, 14 pt, opened with Return from the Graphite symbol: Game first (STRUTHIO); Stop all jobs directly beneath (the Master Stop, scoped in words to the work Graphite manages); the process list: active jobs as they started, the queue with each row's place number at the left (its order: drag, Earlier, Later) and its niceness slider under it (two different controls); Graphite services On · Off · Restart (Graphite's own services); then, set apart, Log out (this login session), Exit Graphite (this Graphite session), Restart and Shut down (this computer). The check holds logind with no login session (as this container truly has none), so the three are unavailable and say so in quiet ink, still in the keyboard's order (the reason is their tooltip, F1's note and what choosing one says); on the owner's computer logind decides. It opens downward from the upper right, the programs list's point-mirror image.

The System menu at 1366 by 768, 14 pt, opened with Return from the Graphite symbol: Game first (STRUTHIO); Stop all jobs directly beneath (the Master Stop, scoped in words to the work Graphite manages); the process list: active jobs as they started, the queue with each row's place number at the left (its order: drag, Earlier, Later) and its niceness slider under it (two different controls); Graphite services On · Off · Restart (Graphite's own services); then, set apart, Log out (this login session), Exit Graphite (this Graphite session), Restart and Shut down (this computer). The check holds logind with no login session (as this container truly has none), so the three are unavailable and say so in quiet ink, still in the keyboard's order (the reason is their tooltip, F1's note and what choosing one says); on the owner's computer logind decides. It opens downward from the upper right, the programs list's point-mirror image. At this height it scrolls; End reaches the last row.

The programs list and the System menu open together at 1920 by 1200 with the guides (dashed yellow): the band's inset from the left and right edges, the head band's foot and the lower band's top; the pink cross is the window's centre, the point they mirror about: the same inset, the same band, one width, one row height, one icon column, the small caption at each far end.

homes.Import: Work ▸ Import (Ingress)… → the Office (Ingress), the transfer's own destination
homes.Export: Work ▸ Export (Egress)… → Files ▸ Egress, the transfer's own destination
homes.Logical cabinet / Existing views: Arrange ▸ Cabinet ▸ Logical Cabinet / Existing Views (with the Existing views' catalogue choice and Concern Overview)
homes.Refresh machine view: Arrange ▸ Refresh Machine View (shows the Machine tab)
homes.Find work… (the cabinet query): the writing line's Find (Ctrl+K): a CABINET section with each matching record, open selects it in the cabinet and opens it
homes.Find a setting… (the settings filter): the writing line's Find: a SETTINGS section, open shows the setting
homes.Centre foot (Timeline, Return thread, Fo: Activity: the Timeline line and its last lines, Return thread, Follow latest; the foot's word opened the Organizer and says so now (the Work trail room is Activity's work list word)
homes.The machine strip: Machine: the Machine row's tooltip carries the line; its facts are the Processor, Memory, Storage and Connections rows
homes.The Hatch groups and Explore the worksho: the cat's programs list: every program and capability A to Z, then Explore the workshop
homes.New Idea and New Project (the old menu): Work ▸ New Idea… (Ctrl+Shift+N) and Work ▸ New Project… (D4: the Work tree's right-click)
homes.Graphite services, Exit Graphite or Retu: the System menu: Graphite services On · Off · Restart, and the separated group
homes.Nice and the kill switch: the System menu: Stop all jobs under Game, then the process list (Ctrl+Shift+F12 and Tools ▸ STOP / KILL as before)
